sources.title: DynaGuard: A Dynamic Guardian Model With User-Defined Policies
sources.snippet: Guardian models play a crucial role in ensuring the safety and ethical behavior of user-facing AI applications by enforcing guardrails and detecting harmful content. While standard guardian models are limited to predefined, static harm categories, we introduce DynaGuard, a suite of dynamic guardian models offering novel flexibility by evaluating text based on user-defined policies, and ...

sources.snippet: TL;DR DynaGuard upgrades guardian models from "static category classifiers" to dynamic models capable of "understanding arbitrary user-defined policies to judge compliance." By synthesizing the DynaBench dataset comprising over 60,000 multi-turn dialogues and 40,000 policies, and training Qwen3 via SFT+GRPO, the 8B model outperforms GPT-4o-mini in custom rule violation detection.
